# Roz

> Roz is a free terminal-based logic gate simulator for Windows (64-bit) and Linux (64-bit). Users type gate expressions such as AND(1, 1), nest gates, and print results with the LOG command.

## Docs

- [README (English)](https://github.com/Thirtexe/Roz/blob/main/README.md): Installation, syntax, gate reference, truth table and FAQ
- [README (فارسی)](https://github.com/Thirtexe/Roz/blob/main/README.fa.md): Persian documentation

## Downloads

- [Releases](https://github.com/Thirtexe/Roz/releases): Roz-Full.exe (Windows) and Roz-Full.AppImage (Linux)
